name: CyberWareX

overview.text: CyberWareX presents eight service groups and 54 endpoints covering public web/Telegram access, search, video transcripts, weather, chain data, token checks, transaction previews and sanctions screening. Counts are operator catalogue claims, not tested services. Six-chain analysis coverage differs from USDC-on-Base payment. Route examples range from $0.001 page text/weather through $0.003 transcripts, $0.00435 search, $0.005 sanctions screening and $0.02 transaction safety assessment. Seven groups advertise limited three-per-day trials; web access lists none. Optional $1-$50 prepaid bundles with 10% extra credit and a reusable key are distinct from individual x402 payments. Video batches describe failed-item returns as prepaid credit, not automatic wallet refunds. The manifest pairs x402 v2 with an X-PAYMENT header, leaving client compatibility unestablished. Token grades, simulation and sanctions/risk labels are bounded assessments, not safe-trading or legal-clearance guarantees, and do not authorize a transaction.

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (20:24-20:59 UTC). No payment, deal or contact with CyberWareX or YourAITools is involved.
